title: EFFICACY OF INFILTRATED MEPIVACAINE AS A LOCAL ANESTHETIC PRIOR TO ARTERIAL PUNCTURE: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED CLINICAL TRIAL
official: EFFICACY OF INFILTRATED MEPIVACAINE AS A LOCAL ANESTHETIC PRIOR TO ARTERIAL PUNCTURE: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED CLINICAL TRIAL
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of infiltrated mepivacaine versus placebo and nothing to reduce pain caused by arterial puncture during blood gas analysis in patients at the Pneumology Outpatient Department.
conditions:
Respiratory disease.
Prescripcion o indicación de gasometría.

interventions.name: Suero Fisiológico Braun 0,9% disolvente para uso parenteral Cloruro de sodio

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. - Adults 18≥80 years; Present a good level of consciousness (Glasgow scale score >15); To have signed the Informed Consent Form.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have a medical condition or difficulty communicating due to psychological disorders, dementia, speech impairment or language barrier; Obtain a Glasgow scale score <15; Being under the effect of alcohol, central nervous system depressant substances or active treatment for pain with opiates; Pregnant or lactating women; Patients whose pathological situation may interfere with the development of the study (e.g. clinical/psychological involvement, trauma to both wrists...); Patients with allergy or previous adverse reactions to amides; Obtaining an abnormal result in the Allen test; Decreased peripheral sensitivity of extremities due to any disease, such as diabetes; Raynaud's phenomenon; Previous participation in the same clinical trial; Inability to give Informed Consent; Do not accept to participate in the study after having been informed verbally and with documentation.
